subject.title: [Feature]: Reusable gateway WebSocket client SDK package

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support a public Gateway WebSocket client SDK now, and should that contract be raw `@openclaw/gateway-client`, higher-level `@openclaw/sdk`, or both?
rationale: Current code contains private internal packages and public docs intentionally warn users not to depend on them; turning either package into a public SDK requires API, versioning, publication, and security-boundary intent.

options.title: Sponsor public SDK design
options.body: Keep this issue open and define package name, adapter model, auth/storage contract, docs, and proof requirements before publishing.

options.title: Fold into App SDK roadmap
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74704 as the canonical public app path and explicitly defer or reject a raw gateway-client package.

options.title: Defer public SDK
options.body: Keep external consumers on documented Gateway protocol/RPC and external reference clients until maintainers decide a supported package is planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor public SDK design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define package name, adapter model, auth/storage contract, docs, and proof requirements before publishing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored and merged the internal gateway-client package extraction most directly implicated by the publication choice.
